verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's entire product is a documented public REST API with extensive parameter documentation (docs-1 to docs-15) and an llms.txt index for AI discoverability (probe-1), plus official CLI and MCP server (probe-4, probe-5) enabling agentic access. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe-2 and probe-3 both 404) and independent hands-on confirmation of API integration ease.
